elements.name: AI4X Explicit Acceptance Baseline
elements.description: Explicit acceptance testcases for AI4X catalog, query, detail progressive disclosure, and data consumption flow.

testcases.name: test_ai4x_platform_catalog_exposes_available_data_range
testcases.description: Explicit acceptance for AI4X catalog data range through MCP.
testcases.Input: Control Point: Call MCP tools/list then tools/call on ai4x_query with command=catalog.

testcases.name: test_ai4x_platform_query_tool_returns_real_data_payload
testcases.description: Explicit acceptance for unified query payload contract through MCP.
testcases.Input: Control Point: Call ai4x_query with command=query and selected sourceId.

testcases.name: test_ai4x_platform_opencti_schema_detail_supports_progressive_disclosure
testcases.description: Explicit acceptance for OpenCTI schema progressive disclosure through schema and detail commands.
testcases.Input: Control Point: Call ai4x_query command=schema then command=detail for selected detail pointer.

testcases.name: test_ai4x_platform_data_consumption_flow_uses_real_ai4x_service
testcases.description: Explicit acceptance for end-to-end AI4X data consumption flow in real service mode.
testcases.Input: Control Point: Trigger real OPENCODE flow with registered AI4X MCP environment.

testcases.name: test_opencode_app_contains_local_tool_runtime_dependencies
testcases.description: Explicit acceptance for local runtime dependencies declared in workspace contracts.
testcases.Input: Control Point: Read opencode.json and workspace.contract.json and inspect isolated runtime paths.
